gold: Photic maculopathy derived from LED light exposure
e7_s4_rationale: The patient's symptoms and imaging findings, including vision loss, scotomas, and OCT changes such as hyperreflective areas and disruption of the ellipsoid zone, are consistent with phototoxic maculopathy caused by exposure to high-intensity LED light.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Solar retinopathy
e7_s4_rejected.why: The patient's exposure was to an LED light, not sunlight.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Photic retinopathy
e7_s4_rejected.why: This term is less specific and does not fully capture the nature of the injury.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Acute zonal occult outer retinopathy
e7_s4_rejected.why: The patient's presentation and imaging findings do not match the typical description of AZOOR.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Central serous chorioretinopathy
e7_s4_rejected.why: The patient's OCT findings and clinical course are not consistent with CSC.
